entities.summary: Guatemala is a sovereign nation in Central America, Americas. Its capital is Guatemala City. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 18.1 million. Area: 108,889 km². Comprehensive index for Guatemala covering Maya civilization heartland (Tikal, El Mirador, Kaminaljuyú), Classic Maya collapse, K'iche'/Kaqchikel kingdoms (Popol Vuh), Alvarado conquest, colonial Antigua capital, Captaincy General of Central America, independence 1821, liberal/conservative struggles, Ubico dictatorship, 1944 October Revolution, Arbenz reforms/1954 CIA coup (United Fruit Company), 36-year civil war 1960-96 (200,000 dead, Mayan genocide under Ríos Montt), and Rigoberta Menchú.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Guatemala's complex history has shaped Central America, with significant impacts from the Classic Maya collapse, colonial Antigua capital, and 36-year civil war that resulted in over 200,000 deaths. The country's struggle for independence and liberal/conservative struggles had regional implications.
